summary: Consumers Energy Company filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for an offering of two series of First Mortgage Bonds due in 20—, with amounts and rates to be determined. The bonds are senior first mortgage obligations, redeemable at the company's option and at 101% for a Tax Credit Event. Proceeds go to the company. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. The filing lacks definitive terms and is an ordinary shelf takedown under an existing registration statement.
